The checker reads the field from data/simulated, confirms the hash, and masks only occurrences of that exact field before matching the sealed phrase; any other occurrence of the phrase still flags, and an entry whose hash stops matching suppresses nothing. Never key an entry on a label alone, never store phrase text here, and add an entry only on an owner ruling recorded in docs/prereg_divergence_log.md.
